fee_sensitivity.decision_knowledge_assumption: constant prescribed decision tariffs; no historical knowledge claim
fee_sensitivity.futures_fee_interpretation: constant experimental tariff over entire sample; effective historical change unknown
fee_sensitivity.minute_fee_clock: start of eligible full-minute window; ledger booking at close

methodology.fees: fixed taker fees without discounts or promotions
methodology.filters: fixed model constraints for every order, including reductions; not historical exchange exemptions
methodology.funding_marks: keep observed settlement mark; if absent use previous closed one-minute mark available by settlement time
methodology.funding_proxy_limits: causal approximation, not an exact settlement price or guaranteed error bound; portfolio paths can change
methodology.funding_proxy_stress: only substituted marks: previous_close * (1 - sign(funding_rate) * funding_proxy_stress_bps / 10000); positive stress worsens short cash flow
methodology.funding_warmup: missing pre-economic settlement marks stay absent; observed rates and independently verified intervals remain required
methodology.liquidation: execution notional charge plus regular taker fee
methodology.maintenance: two prescribed continuous tiers; stress scales both rates and deductions

minute_execution.eligible_window: the first full minute beginning at or after submission
minute_execution.fill_time: eligible minute close, after price and volume are known
minute_execution.partial_fills: one native fill event records the executable quantity
minute_execution.remainder: unfilled quantity expires at the eligible minute close
minute_execution.source_price: quote-volume divided by base-volume for the eligible minute
